# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.



[Stoma Care] ;

### Stoma Care

Information, support and advice on post operative lifestyle for ileostomy, urostomy, colostomy and
general stoma care patients.
[Read more][224] [Advanced Wound Care] ;

### Advanced Wound Care

Leading the way in advanced wound and skin care innovation. Learn more about all our high quality
products to help heal wounds faster.
[Read more][225]




## Healthy Bonds. Our bonds determine who we are.

;

There’s no bond more important than the one with your own body. Convatec helps you create a healthy
bond with yourself, your stoma. And then, with the world around you.

Start creating a healthy bond with your stoma by finding the answers you need quickly with me+
Answers.

The me+™ programme offers you the right support so you feel stronger, more confident and ready for
what’s ahead. The ostomy products and support you need, tips and advice for stoma care, and a
community you can grow with. Have questions about living with an stoma? Our me+ specialists and
stoma nurses are waiting to help you, call 18002674989 or write to us at
customerserviceindia@convatec.com

[ Join me+ today ][226]

## Feature Highlight: AWC, CC, + Flexi-Seal

Hydrofiber® Technology

### Our Hydrofiber® Technology

**Hydrofiber^{®} Technology is a soft, absorbent material that transforms into a gel on contact with
wound fluid.**

For more than 25 years, Convatec has been helping clinicians to improve patient outcomes, enabling
patients to move on with their lives through the use of Hydrofiber^{®} Technology – globally proven
and trusted. Discover how the unique, innovative Hydrofiber^{®} Technology can help you make a real
impact on the lives of people living with a wound.

Our Hydrofiber® Technology Learn more

[ Learn more ][227] [three doctors] ; Flexi-Seal™

### Flexi-Seal™ FMS

Flexi-Seal™ Fecal Management System (FMS) is an indwelling fecal management catheter intended for
use to manage fecal incontinence through the collection of liquid to semi-liquid stool and to
provide access to administer medications.

Flexi-Seal™ FMS Learn more

[ Learn more ][228] [Flexi-Seal™ FMS] ;

## Sign up and be the first to know about our exciting innovations.

Learning how to live fully with a condition takes education, resources and support. And with me+, we
make sure you don’t have to figure it out alone. Getting the benefits of me+ is easy. Join today for
complete support.

# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.



[Stoma Care] ;

### Stoma Care

Information, support and advice on post operative lifestyle for ileostomy, urostomy, colostomy and
general stoma care patients.
[Read more][224] [Advanced Wound Care] ;

### Advanced Wound Care

Leading the way in advanced wound and skin care innovation. Learn more about all our high quality
products to help heal wounds faster.
[Read more][225]




## Healthy Bonds. Our bonds determine who we are.

;

There’s no bond more important than the one with your own body. Convatec helps you create a healthy
bond with yourself, your stoma. And then, with the world around you.

Start creating a healthy bond with your stoma by finding the answers you need quickly with me+
Answers.

The me+™ programme offers you the right support so you feel stronger, more confident and ready for
what’s ahead. The ostomy products and support you need, tips and advice for stoma care, and a
community you can grow with. Have questions about living with an stoma? Our me+ specialists and
stoma nurses are waiting to help you, call 18002674989 or write to us at
customerserviceindia@convatec.com

[ Join me+ today ][226]

## Feature Highlight: AWC, CC, + Flexi-Seal

Hydrofiber® Technology

### Our Hydrofiber® Technology

**Hydrofiber^{®} Technology is a soft, absorbent material that transforms into a gel on contact with
wound fluid.**

For more than 25 years, Convatec has been helping clinicians to improve patient outcomes, enabling
patients to move on with their lives through the use of Hydrofiber^{®} Technology – globally proven
and trusted. Discover how the unique, innovative Hydrofiber^{®} Technology can help you make a real
impact on the lives of people living with a wound.

Our Hydrofiber® Technology Learn more

### Flexi-Seal™ FMS

Flexi-Seal™ Fecal Management System (FMS) is an indwelling fecal management catheter intended for
use to manage fecal incontinence through the collection of liquid to semi-liquid stool and to
provide access to administer medications.

Flexi-Seal™ FMS Learn more

complete support.

the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

Home

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

★★★★★

## Our Products

[[IV-Cannula]][56]

### [IV Cannula][57]

An integral part of intravenous therapy, the [IV cannula][58] is inserted into the patient's hand to
inject medication directly into the bloodstream or to withdraw body fluid.

[[Safety-IV-Cannula]][59]

### [Safety IV Cannula][60]

A [Safety IV Cannula][61] is a sterile, single-use medical device designed to provide safe and
effective venous access while minimizing the risk of needlestick injuries.

[[Respiratory-Devices]][62]

### [IV Infusion Set][63]

Effective for the implementation of IV therapy, many parts come together to form an [ IV infusion
set ][64]. It consists of a needle, an IV drip and chamber, and a cannula.

[[Hypodermic-Syringe]][65]

### [Hypodermic Syringe][66]

An extra sharp needle instrumental for withdrawing blood from the body, a [ hypodermic syringe][67]
is a thin and hollow tube with a pointed tip.

[[Respiratory-Devices]][68]

### [Respiratory Devices][69]

Patients with [ respiratory ][70]dysfunctions benefit from these tools and devices that provide
support for proper inhalation and exhalation and administration of nasal medicines.

[[Gloves]][71]

### [Gloves][72]

With great elasticity and flexibility, [ medical gloves][73] allow healthcare providers to examine
and diagnose patients efficiently without the fear of getting infected themselves.

[[three way cock ext line]][74]

### [Three Way Stop Cock ][75]

A [Three Way Stop Cock][76] is a device used to control and direct the flow of fluids in IV therapy
and medical procedures.

### From a Local Store to Global Partners

Mezzan Holding’s origins date back to the 1940s, when a young and ambitious Kuwaiti entrepreneur
opened his first retail store selling consumer-ready imported products. These products include rice,
sugar, and other food staples from neighboring countries, and later from Europe, the USA, and Asia.

That entrepreneur was the late Jassim Mohammad Ali Al Wazzan, and what he started over 80 years ago
is today one of the region’s most reputable and trusted conglomerates with operations spanning
across six countries through 34 vertically integrated companies.

[Read Our Success Story][125]

### From a Local Store to Global Partners

Mezzan Holding’s origins date back to the 1940s, when a young and ambitious Kuwaiti entrepreneur
opened his first retail store selling consumer-ready imported products. These products include rice,
sugar, and other food staples from neighboring countries, and later from Europe, the USA, and Asia.

That entrepreneur was the late Jassim Mohammad Ali Al Wazzan, and what he started over 80 years ago
is today one of the region’s most reputable and trusted conglomerates with operations spanning
across six countries through 34 vertically integrated companies.

[Read Our Success Story][125]

# MEET MGE

# Exceeding Your Expectations

MG Electric (Colchester) Ltd. is a British manufacturing company based in the South East of England.
Founded in 1945

as an installer and repairer of electrical equipment, our innovative approach to engineering has
helped us expand over

the years into four diverse Commercial areas.


As a specialist SME in the manufacturing industry, MGE is committed to providing innovative high
quality products backed-up with exceptional customer service from our talented team to make sure
your needs are not only met, but exceeded.


All MGE equipment is manufactured to the highest standards in accordance with current European CE
Legislation,

ISO 13485 Quality Management System, and for our Medical equipment, the Medical Device Directive
(MDD) and the newer Medical Device Regulation (MDR).

[Company News][33]
[Company History][34]
[ce mark 2797 73_90 pixel.jpg]
[Thumb_mark-of-trust-certified-ISO-13485-quality-management-for-medical-devices-black-logo-]

### MGE Medical

MGE's SAM medical range of products includes an extensive range of general and specialist suction
equipment for ward and theatre, portable devices for ambulance, central system pipeline regulators,
nebulisers and accessories.

[Find Out More][35]

### MGE Print

MGE's PRESSMATE range of equipment includes refrigerated dampening circulators, alcohol control,
roller chillers, fount dosers, fount filtration systems, varnish coaters, and combination and RO
water treatment units. Pressmate units are designed for use with any sheet fed or web printing
press.

[Find Out More][36]

### MGE Converting & Rewinding

MGE's WEBCON range of Converting Equipment includes fully automatic and semi-automatic systems for
rewinding and slitting \ rewinding films, foils and specialist papers.

[Find Out More][37]

### MGE Machine Tool & Circulation Pumps

MGE have offered a range of centrifugal pumps for over 50 years, initially to the UK machine tool
industry but more recently, worldwide in a variety of applications. Over this time, MGE pumps have
become synonymous with quality and reliabilty.

[Find Out More][38]
[Back to Top][39]

## OMRON connect

The next generation OMRON connect US/CAN/EMEA app is here and it syncs with every one of our
connected blood pressure monitors and select body composition monitors! This app release features
expanded insights and new look and feel for monitoring your heart health. By wirelessly connecting
via **Bluetooth™**, you can easily upload, store and even share your heart history data with family
or physicians. And it even keeps track of your weight—so you can achieve your broader health goals.

We believe the next generation won’t be defined by age, but by a world without heart attacks or
strokes. This is a world-changing mind-set we call Going for Zero™. We do our part through
technology supporting personal fitness, heart health, healthy lungs and freedom from pain. You bring
this commitment to life by understanding and sharing heart health with every step.

Tengrant

### Welcome to The Vacuum House, your one-stop destination for all things vacuum and cleaning.

We proudly stock an extensive range of leading vacuum brands, including Hoover, Vorwerk, Roborock,
Westinghouse, Tineco, Sauber, Wertheim, Miele, Numatic, Pullman, Ghibli, and Electrolux. Beyond
vacuums, we offer a wide selection of accessories such as bags, filters, and spare parts, as well as
floor cleaning machines and carpet cleaners to meet your every need.

Our expertise doesn’t stop at sales—we’re Perth’s only authorised Roborock specialist and provide
repair and maintenance services for most major brand-name robot vacuums, including Ecovac’s Deebot
and Roomba models. With over 20 years of experience in Dyson repairs, we’re committed to keeping
your machines running at their best.

From shampooing machines to floor scrubbers and commercial vacuums, *The Vacuum House* is here to
help you achieve a cleaner, healthier space with trusted products and expert service.

## Overview of Services

#### [Repairs/Servicing][15]

Repairs/Servicing

At The Vacuum House, we’re Perth’s only authorised Roborock specialist and experts in repairing most
major robot vacuum brands, including Ecovac’s Deebot and Roomba. With over 20 years of experience in
Dyson repairs, we deliver reliable, efficient service to keep your cleaning equipment running like
new.

[ Learn More ][16]

#### [Product Range][17]

Product Range

At *The Vacuum House*, we stock leading vacuum brands like Hoover, Roborock, Miele, Dyson, and more.
We also offer bags, filters, spare parts, carpet cleaners, floor scrubbers, shampooing machines, and
commercial vacuums—everything you need for effective cleaning!

[ Learn more ][18]

#### [Contact][19]

Contact
We’d love to hear from you! Whether you need assistance with repairs, servicing, or finding the
perfect cleaning solution, our team at The Vacuum House is here to help.
 
Feel free to drop by our store, give us a call, or send us an email. You can also reach out via our
online form, and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible. Let us help you keep your space
spotless!
 
[ Contact us ][20]

# 5.0

#### Our average customer rating is 5 based on 12 reviews

## What Our Customers Are Saying

We were not the easiest customers to please, but Dan found a way to answer our questions and meet
our needs with a genuine and pleasant attitude. Not pushy, just good service. Highly recommend the
Vacuum House. We visited from Bunbury and we'd make the journey again should we ever need another
machine (not likely soon with the quality brands they sell!).
[Scott Bazely][21]
We attended The Vacuum House on Saturday after recommendations for a repair on our Tenico mop,
travelling an hour to the store. We were greeted by a very lovely, down to earth owner who actioned
our repair immediately, we happened to be very in luck this day. The repair was completed and the
owner even helped us take the parts back to our car. Excellent customer service and I highly
recommend anyone in need of a repair or new purchase to go in store.
[Keisha McArthur][22]

When you’re shopping for medical supplies, the last thing you want to do is navigate multiple
stores, fight against budget restraints, and deal with complicated pickup or delivery requirements.
At Vitality Medical, we work hard to take the stress out of purchasing medical supplies, letting you
worry less about your purchase and more about the health of you or your loved one.
* ## Delivering Quality and Reliability
  
  Vitality Medical stands out as a leading online destination for discount medical supplies and
  equipment, offering over 100,000 products from reputable brands. Since 2000, over 2.5 million
  customers have trusted Vitality Medical for their healthcare needs, conveniently browsing and
  purchasing a wide range of medical supplies online. This has made Vitality Medical a go-to source
  for both consumers and resellers. Our commitment to quality and service is recognized by top
  ratings, including an [**A+ from the Better Business Bureau**][98] and a [**4.2-star rating on
  Google**][99]. Discover more about our success on [**Bloomberg**][100] or [**Inc. 5000**][101],
  and read [**testimonials**][102] on [**Trustpilot**][103] and [**Reseller Ratings**][104].
* ## Committed to Affordable Medical Supplies
  
  At Vitality Medical, affordability and quality go hand in hand. Our product experts are dedicated
  to helping customers find medical supplies online that fits both their needs and their budgets.
  We’re committed to offering the best prices. **If you find a lower price elsewhere, we'll match
  it**. Our national network of warehouses, stocked with top-tier brands, guarantees fast and
  reliable shipping. Many of these warehouses are strategically located near major metropolitan
  areas, ensuring that your medical supplies arrive quickly and cost-effectively, right when you
  need them. Sign up for our newsletter to stay informed about exclusive sales and promotions. We
  regularly offer discounts on both innovative new products and everyday essentials.
* ## Why Choose Vitality Medical
  
  Navigating the world of home medical supplies can be overwhelming. Vitality Medical is here to
  guide you every step of the way. Our customer service team receives regular training to ensure
  they can answer all your product-related questions. If an item is out of stock, our team will go
  the extra mile to find it, underscoring our commitment to helping you **Add Vitality to Your
  Life**.
  
  For purchasing agents in hospitals, caregiver facilities, or retail, our [Business to
  Business][105] section offers tailored solutions and information to meet your specific needs.
  
  When you choose Vitality Medical as your online medical supply store, you’re choosing convenience,
  dependability, and expertise. Explore our products today to find the equipment you need. You can
  also [contact our team][106] to learn more about our products, get help navigating our
  collections, and make an informed, confident purchase.

worry less about your purchase and more about the health of you or your loved one.
* ## Delivering Quality and Reliability
  
  Vitality Medical stands out as a leading online destination for discount medical supplies and
  equipment, offering over 100,000 products from reputable brands. Since 2000, over 2.5 million
  customers have trusted Vitality Medical for their healthcare needs, conveniently browsing and
  purchasing a wide range of medical supplies online. This has made Vitality Medical a go-to source
  for both consumers and resellers. Our commitment to quality and service is recognized by top

  At Vitality Medical, affordability and quality go hand in hand. Our product experts are dedicated
  to helping customers find medical supplies online that fits both their needs and their budgets.
  We’re committed to offering the best prices. **If you find a lower price elsewhere, we'll match
  it**. Our national network of warehouses, stocked with top-tier brands, guarantees fast and
  reliable shipping. Many of these warehouses are strategically located near major metropolitan
  areas, ensuring that your medical supplies arrive quickly and cost-effectively, right when you
  need them. Sign up for our newsletter to stay informed about exclusive sales and promotions. We
  regularly offer discounts on both innovative new products and everyday essentials.

  Navigating the world of home medical supplies can be overwhelming. Vitality Medical is here to
  guide you every step of the way. Our customer service team receives regular training to ensure
  they can answer all your product-related questions. If an item is out of stock, our team will go

  Life**.
  
  For purchasing agents in hospitals, caregiver facilities, or retail, our [Business to
  Business][105] section offers tailored solutions and information to meet your specific needs.
  
  When you choose Vitality Medical as your online medical supply store, you’re choosing convenience,
  dependability, and expertise. Explore our products today to find the equipment you need. You can
  also [contact our team][106] to learn more about our products, get help navigating our
